This video examines Lithuania’s evacuation challenge, the vulnerable border areas near Belarus and Kaliningrad, the capacity gap facing local officials, and why the Baltic region is strengthening civilian preparedness amid rising NATO-Russia tensions.

item.description: A former bodyguard of Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh is accused of helping prepare attacks against Jewish and Israeli targets in Europe.
